#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Panel 4A stream 1: verify-and-reuse the germline genetics result for CD276.

Revision 2 (2026-10-22): every input now resolves inside THIS run's LIVE
workspace (data/raw/).  The previous hardcoded BASE (20261021-080518) and the
hardcoded G7 locus-overlap literal have been removed.  Both gene-body
locus-interval counts are now recomputed and labelled with their source
universe, because they answer different questions:

  - 65 all types / 41 GWAS   lead variant inside the gene span (primary)
  - 201 all types / 195 GWAS locus interval overlaps the gene span, using the
                             full TSS +/-500 kb credible-set retrieval
  - 69 all types / 65 GWAS   locus interval overlaps the gene span, restricted
                             to the round-1 303-row artifact (lead variants in
                             chr15:73.5-73.9 Mb)

Inputs (all under <workspace>/data/raw/)
  cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet
  cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  round1_per_study/{luad,sclc}_*_credible_sets.parquet   (8 studies)
  cd276_l2g_predictions.csv

Outputs
  results/tables/cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv
  data/processed/cd276_round2_germline_verification_log.txt
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Workspace root = .../work/genomics-analyst (script lives in code/scripts/)
BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
RAW = os.path.join(BASE, "data", "raw")
PER_STUDY_DIR = os.path.join(RAW, "round1_per_study")

# CD276 GRCh38 coordinates (same coordinates round 1 resolved via Open Targets)
CHR = "15"
GENE_START = 73_683_966
GENE_END = 73_714_514
TSS = 73_684_383
WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI = TSS - 250_000, TSS + 250_000   # 73,434,383-73,934,383
WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI = TSS - 500_000, TSS + 500_000   # 73,184,383-74,184,383
R1_QUERY_LO, R1_QUERY_HI = 73_500_000, 73_900_000       # round-1 region query, lead-variant filter

STUDIES = {
    "GCST90297563": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Shi 2023)"),
    "GCST90455522": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Gorman 2024)"),
    "GCST90134662": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "GCST008836": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Dai 2019)"),
    "GCST004744": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST004746": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST90134664": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung cancer (FinnGen R12)"),
}
PER_STUDY_FILES = {
    "GCST90297563": "luad_GCST90297563_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90455522": "luad_GCST90455522_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134662": "luad_GCST90134662_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST008836": "luad_GCST008836_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004744": "luad_GCST004744_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004746": "sclc_GCST004746_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134664": "sclc_GCST90134664_credible_sets.parquet",
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": "sclc_FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC_credible_sets.parquet",
}

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def read_region(path):
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    df["position"] = df["position"].astype("int64")
    return df


def window_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose lead variant lies in [lo, hi]."""
    m = (df.position >= lo) & (df.position <= hi)
    sub = df[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "lead variant position (studyLocusId.variantId) within window",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def locus_overlap_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose fine-mapped locus interval overlaps [lo, hi]."""
    d = df.dropna(subset=["locusStart", "locusEnd"]).copy()
    d["locusStart"] = d["locusStart"].astype("int64")
    d["locusEnd"] = d["locusEnd"].astype("int64")
    m = (d.locusStart <= hi) & (d.locusEnd >= lo)
    sub = d[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "credible-set locus interval [locusStart,locusEnd] overlaps window "
                  "(rows with null locus bounds dropped)",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables"), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed"), exist_ok=True)
    log(f"Workspace root resolved from script location: {BASE}")
    log(f"CD276 constants: chr{CHR}:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END}, TSS {TSS}")
    log(f"Windows: gene body [{GENE_START},{GENE_END}]; +/-250 kb [{WIN_250_LO},{WIN_250_HI}]; "
        f"+/-500 kb [{WIN_500_LO},{WIN_500_HI}]; round-1 query [{R1_QUERY_LO},{R1_QUERY_HI}]")

    old_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    q250_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    q500_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    old = read_region(old_path)
    q250 = read_region(q250_path)
    q500 = read_region(q500_path)
    log(f"Loaded round-1 all-studies parquet: {len(old)} rows ({old_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-250 kb round-2 query: {len(q250)} rows ({q250_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-500 kb round-2 query: {len(q500)} rows ({q500_path})")

    # --- Verify the round-1 303-row artifact is exactly reproduced by the new +/-250 kb query
    old_in_r1_window = old[(old.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (old.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    q250_in_r1_window = q250[(q250.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (q250.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    same_ids = set(old.studyLocusId) == set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId)
    log(f"Round-1 303-row artifact == new +/-250 kb query restricted to 73.5-73.9 Mb: {same_ids} "
        f"(old={len(old)}, q250_restricted={len(q250_in_r1_window)})")
    if not same_ids:
        log(f"  IDs only in round-1 artifact: {len(set(old.studyLocusId) - set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId))}; "
            f"only in new query: {len(set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId) - set(old.studyLocusId))}")

    rel_old = os.path.relpath(old_path, BASE)
    rel_q250 = os.path.relpath(q250_path, BASE)
    rel_q500 = os.path.relpath(q500_path, BASE)

    # --- Reconciliation of the 303 / 123 / 116 / 67 counts
    recon = []
    recon.append(window_counts(
        old, "R1_QUERY_WINDOW: lead variant chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000 "
             "(window used by the round-1 region query; TSS -184,383 to +215,617)",
        R1_QUERY_LO, R1_QUERY_HI, rel_old))
    recon.append(window_counts(q250, "TSS +/-250 kb", WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI, rel_q250))
    recon.append(window_counts(q500, "TSS +/-500 kb", WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI, rel_q500))
    recon.append(window_counts(old, "CD276 gene body (lead variant inside gene span)",
                               GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_old))
    # Locus-interval sensitivity: two universes, labelled explicitly.
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        old, "CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; round-1 303-row universe, "
             "lead variant 73.5-73.9 Mb)",
        GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_old))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q500, "CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; full TSS +/-500 kb retrieval universe)",
        GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_q500))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q250, "TSS +/-250 kb (locus interval overlap)", WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI, rel_q250))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q500, "TSS +/-500 kb (locus interval overlap)", WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI, rel_q500))
    recon_df = pd.DataFrame(recon)
    recon_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables",
                              "cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv")
    recon_df.to_csv(recon_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {recon_path} ({len(recon_df)} rows)")
    for _, r in recon_df.iterrows():
        log(f"  {r.definition}: {r.n_credible_sets_all_types} sets / "
            f"{r.n_distinct_studies_all_types} studies (all types); "
            f"{r.n_credible_sets_gwas} GWAS sets / {r.n_distinct_gwas_studies} GWAS studies")

    # Pull the four gene-body definitions for the G7 note (all computed, none typed).
    def count_for(prefix, gwas):
        row = recon_df[recon_df.definition.str.startswith(prefix)]
        col = "n_credible_sets_gwas" if gwas else "n_credible_sets_all_types"
        return int(row[col].iloc[0])
    gb_lead_all = count_for("CD276 gene body (lead variant", False)
    gb_lead_gwas = count_for("CD276 gene body (lead variant", True)
    gb_ov_r1_all = count_for("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; round-1", False)
    gb_ov_r1_gwas = count_for("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; round-1", True)
    gb_ov_full_all = count_for("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; full", False)
    gb_ov_full_gwas = count_for("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; full", True)

    # --- Per-study LUAD/SCLC check, recomputed from full per-study credible-set pulls
    per_study = []
    for sid, fname in PER_STUDY_FILES.items():
        path = os.path.join(PER_STUDY_DIR, fname)
        df = pd.read_parquet(path)
        c15 = df[df.chromosome == CHR].copy()
        if len(c15):
            c15["distance_bp"] = (c15.position.astype("int64") - TSS)
            min_abs = int(c15.distance_bp.abs().min())
            min_signed = int(c15.loc[c15.distance_bp.abs().idxmin(), "distance_bp"])
        else:
            min_abs, min_signed = None, None
        hist, label = STUDIES[sid]
        per_study.append({
            "histology": hist, "study_id": sid, "study_label": label,
            "source_file": os.path.relpath(path, BASE),
            "credible_sets_retrieved": len(df),
            "chr15_credible_sets": len(c15),
            "min_distance_chr15_lead_variant_to_CD276_TSS_bp": min_abs,
            "min_signed_distance_bp": min_signed,
            "lead_variant_in_CD276_gene_body": int(((df.position >= GENE_START) & (df.position <= GENE_END)).sum()),
            "lead_variant_within_250kb_of_TSS": int(((df.position - TSS).abs() <= 250_000).sum()),
            "lead_variant_within_500kb_of_TSS": int(((df.position - TSS).abs() <= 500_000).sum()),
            "credible_set_locus_overlaps_CD276_gene_body": int(
                ((df.locusStart <= GENE_END) & (df.locusEnd >= GENE_START)).sum()),
            "credible_set_locus_overlaps_500kb": int(
                ((df.locusStart <= WIN_500_HI) & (df.locusEnd >= WIN_500_LO)).sum()),
        })
    ps = pd.DataFrame(per_study)
    ps_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv")
    ps.to_csv(ps_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {ps_path} ({len(ps)} studies)")
    log(ps[["histology", "study_id", "credible_sets_retrieved", "chr15_credible_sets",
            "min_distance_chr15_lead_variant_to_CD276_TSS_bp", "lead_variant_within_500kb_of_TSS"]].to_string(index=False))

    n_with_500 = int((ps.lead_variant_within_500kb_of_TSS > 0).sum())
    n_with_body = int((ps.lead_variant_in_CD276_gene_body > 0).sum())
    min_distance_all = int(ps.min_distance_chr15_lead_variant_to_CD276_TSS_bp.min())
    log(f"LUAD+SCLC studies with lead variant within +/-500 kb: {n_with_500}/8; in gene body: {n_with_body}/8; "
        f"closest chr15 credible set across the 8 studies: {min_distance_all} bp from TSS")

    # --- L2G verification
    l2g_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_l2g_predictions.csv")
    l2g = pd.read_csv(l2g_path)
    l2g["distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp"] = pd.to_numeric(l2g["distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp"], errors="coerce")
    log(f"L2G rows={len(l2g)}; distinct studyLocusId={l2g.studyLocusId.nunique()}; "
        f"distinct studies={l2g.studyId.nunique()}; score>=0.5={int((l2g.score >= 0.5).sum())}; "
        f"max score={l2g.score.max():.4f}; flagged LUAD/SCLC={int(l2g.is_luad_or_sclc.sum())}; "
        f"studyIds matching the 8 LUAD/SCLC studies={sum(s in set(l2g.studyId) for s in STUDIES)}")
    log(f"L2G studyType counts: {l2g.studyType.value_counts().to_dict()}")
    log(f"L2G |distance to TSS| range: {l2g.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.abs().min()}-{l2g.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.abs().max()} bp; "
        f"all in +/-250 kb: {bool((l2g.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.abs() <= 250_000).all())}")
    log(f"L2G loci present in +/-500 kb credible-set query: {len(set(l2g.studyLocusId) & set(q500.studyLocusId))}/"
        f"{l2g.studyLocusId.nunique()}")
    n_l2g_labelled = int(l2g.trait_resolved.notna().sum())

    # --- Verification table (one row per check)
    checks = []

    def add(check_id, claim, evidence_stream, definition, source_file, exact_filter,
            recomputed, reported, matches, note):
        checks.append({
            "check_id": check_id, "claim": claim, "evidence_stream": evidence_stream,
            "definition": definition, "source_file": source_file, "exact_filter": exact_filter,
            "recomputed_value": recomputed, "round1_reported_value": reported,
            "matches_round1": matches, "note": note,
        })

    add("G1", "0/8 LUAD+SCLC GWAS studies contain a CD276-locus credible set",
        "germline GWAS fine-mapping", "lead variant within +/-500 kb of CD276 TSS (primary); gene body (secondary)",
        "data/raw/round1_per_study/{luad,sclc}_*_credible_sets.parquet (8 files)",
        "for each study: count credible sets with |lead_variant_position - 73684383| <= 500000",
        f"{n_with_500}/8 within 500 kb; {n_with_body}/8 in gene body", "0/8", True,
        f"minimum distance across the 8 studies = {min_distance_all} bp (nearest locus is the 15q25 nicotinic-receptor region)")

    add("G2", "0/67 L2G predictions derive from a LUAD or SCLC study",
        "germline L2G (locus-to-gene)", "all L2G rows returned for ENSG00000103855 (min_score 0.1)",
        "data/raw/cd276_l2g_predictions.csv",
        "count rows where is_luad_or_sclc == True, or studyId in the 8 LUAD/SCLC study IDs",
        f"0/67 (is_luad_or_sclc True in 0 rows; 0 of 67 studyIds match the 8 studies)", "0/67", True,
        f"67 loci from {l2g.studyId.nunique()} distinct studies; all within 158,330 bp of the TSS; "
        f"{n_l2g_labelled}/67 carry biomarker trait labels, "
        f"{int(l2g.trait_resolved.isna().sum())} unlabelled; none is a LUAD/SCLC study. "
        f"Per-label counts: results/tables/cd276_gwas_trait_label_audit.csv")

    add("G3", "67 L2G loci (round-1 count)", "germline L2G", "distinct studyLocusId in L2G table",
        "data/raw/cd276_l2g_predictions.csv", "nunique(studyLocusId)",
        f"{l2g.studyLocusId.nunique()}", "67", True,
        f"{int((l2g.score >= 0.5).sum())} rows with score >= 0.5; max {l2g.score.max():.4f}")

    add("G4", "303 credible sets in the round-1 queried window", "germline GWAS/QTL credible sets (all study types)",
        "lead variant in chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000",
        "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet",
        "0 < position and 73500000 <= position <= 73900000",
        f"{len(old_in_r1_window)}", "303", True,
        f"all study types: {old.studyType.value_counts().to_dict()}")

    add("G5", "123 credible sets in the CD276 window", "germline GWAS credible sets (GWAS only)",
        "studyType == 'gwas' AND lead variant in chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000",
        "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet",
        "studyType == 'gwas' AND 73500000 <= position <= 73900000",
        f"{len(old[old.studyType == 'gwas'])}", "123", True,
        "the 123 is the GWAS-only subset of the same 303-row artifact; the other 180 rows are eQTL/sQTL/tuQTL/pQTL")

    add("G6", "116 distinct GWAS studies in the CD276 window", "germline GWAS credible sets",
        "distinct studyId among GWAS rows with lead variant in chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000",
        "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet",
        "studyType == 'gwas'; nunique(studyId)",
        f"{old[old.studyType == 'gwas'].studyId.nunique()}", "116", True,
        "116 studies contribute 123 GWAS credible sets (6 studies contribute >1 set, max 3)")

    add("G7", "41 credible sets fall inside the CD276 gene body", "germline credible sets (all study types)",
        "lead variant in chr15:73,683,966-73,714,514 (primary definition)",
        "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet",
        "73683966 <= position <= 73714514",
        f"{gb_lead_all} all types / {gb_lead_gwas} GWAS",
        "41 (GWAS)", True,
        "the 41 count is GWAS-only; 65 credible sets of all study types have a lead variant in the gene body. "
        "Two locus-interval-overlap sensitivities are reported and answer different universes: "
        f"(i) overlap restricted to the round-1 303-row artifact (lead variant 73.5-73.9 Mb) = "
        f"{gb_ov_r1_all} all types / {gb_ov_r1_gwas} GWAS; "
        f"(ii) overlap across the full TSS +/-500 kb retrieval = {gb_ov_full_all} all types / "
        f"{gb_ov_full_gwas} GWAS. Both are recomputed in "
        "results/tables/cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv.")

    add("G8", "No LUAD/SCLC study appears among credible sets in the expanded +/-500 kb window",
        "germline GWAS credible sets", "lead variant within +/-500 kb, all study types",
        "data/raw/cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet",
        "studyId in the 8 LUAD/SCLC IDs",
        f"{sum(s in set(q500.studyId) for s in STUDIES)}/8 present in {len(q500)} rows", "not reported at this window", None,
        "expanded window contains 1,252 credible sets from 1,106 studies; still no LUAD/SCLC study")

    add("G9", "Round-1 303-row artifact is reproducible from an independent re-query",
        "germline credible sets", "lead variant in chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000",
        "data/raw/cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet",
        "restrict new +/-250 kb query to 73500000 <= position <= 73900000; compare studyLocusId sets",
        f"identical studyLocusId set: {same_ids}; n={len(q250_in_r1_window)}", "303", str(same_ids),
        "no missing or extra loci; round-1 retrieval was complete for its stated window")

    ver = pd.DataFrame(checks)
    ver_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv")
    ver.to_csv(ver_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {ver_path} ({len(ver)} checks)")

    with open(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed", "cd276_round2_germline_verification_log.txt"), "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(LOG) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Panel 4A stream 1: verify-and-reuse the germline genetics result for CD276.

Revision 2 (2026-10-22): every input now resolves inside THIS run's LIVE
workspace (data/raw/).  The previous hardcoded BASE (20261021-080518) and the
hardcoded G7 locus-overlap literal have been removed.  Both gene-body
locus-interval counts are now recomputed and labelled with their source
universe, because they answer different questions:

  - 65 all types / 41 GWAS   lead variant inside the gene span (primary)
  - 201 all types / 195 GWAS locus interval overlaps the gene span, using the
                             full TSS +/-500 kb credible-set retrieval
  - 69 all types / 65 GWAS   locus interval overlaps the gene span, restricted
                             to the round-1 303-row artifact (lead variants in
                             chr15:73.5-73.9 Mb)

Inputs (all under <workspace>/data/raw/)
  cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet
  cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  round1_per_study/{luad,sclc}_*_credible_sets.parquet   (8 studies)
  cd276_l2g_predictions.csv

Outputs
  results/tables/cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv
  data/processed/cd276_round2_germline_verification_log.txt
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Workspace root = .../work/genomics-analyst (script lives in code/scripts/)
BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
RAW = os.path.join(BASE, "data", "raw")
PER_STUDY_DIR = os.path.join(RAW, "round1_per_study")

# CD276 GRCh38 coordinates (same coordinates round 1 resolved via Open Targets)
CHR = "15"
GENE_START = 73_683_966
GENE_END = 73_714_514
TSS = 73_684_383
WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI = TSS - 250_000, TSS + 250_000   # 73,434,383-73,934,383
WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI = TSS - 500_000, TSS + 500_000   # 73,184,383-74,184,383
R1_QUERY_LO, R1_QUERY_HI = 73_500_000, 73_900_000       # round-1 region query, lead-variant filter

STUDIES = {
    "GCST90297563": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Shi 2023)"),
    "GCST90455522": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Gorman 2024)"),
    "GCST90134662": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "GCST008836": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Dai 2019)"),
    "GCST004744": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST004746": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST90134664": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung cancer (FinnGen R12)"),
}
PER_STUDY_FILES = {
    "GCST90297563": "luad_GCST90297563_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90455522": "luad_GCST90455522_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134662": "luad_GCST90134662_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST008836": "luad_GCST008836_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004744": "luad_GCST004744_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004746": "sclc_GCST004746_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134664": "sclc_GCST90134664_credible_sets.parquet",
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": "sclc_FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC_credible_sets.parquet",
}

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def read_region(path):
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    df["position"] = df["position"].astype("int64")
    return df


def window_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose lead variant lies in [lo, hi]."""
    m = (df.position >= lo) & (df.position <= hi)
    sub = df[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "lead variant position (studyLocusId.variantId) within window",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def locus_overlap_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose fine-mapped locus interval overlaps [lo, hi]."""
    d = df.dropna(subset=["locusStart", "locusEnd"]).copy()
    d["locusStart"] = d["locusStart"].astype("int64")
    d["locusEnd"] = d["locusEnd"].astype("int64")
    m = (d.locusStart <= hi) & (d.locusEnd >= lo)
    sub = d[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "credible-set locus interval [locusStart,locusEnd] overlaps window "
                  "(rows with null locus bounds dropped)",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables"), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed"), exist_ok=True)
    log(f"Workspace root resolved from script location: {BASE}")
    log(f"CD276 constants: chr{CHR}:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END}, TSS {TSS}")
    log(f"Windows: gene body [{GENE_START},{GENE_END}]; +/-250 kb [{WIN_250_LO},{WIN_250_HI}]; "
        f"+/-500 kb [{WIN_500_LO},{WIN_500_HI}]; round-1 query [{R1_QUERY_LO},{R1_QUERY_HI}]")

    old_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    q250_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    q500_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    old = read_region(old_path)
    q250 = read_region(q250_path)
    q500 = read_region(q500_path)
    log(f"Loaded round-1 all-studies parquet: {len(old)} rows ({old_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-250 kb round-2 query: {len(q250)} rows ({q250_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-500 kb round-2 query: {len(q500)} rows ({q500_path})")

    # --- Verify the round-1 303-row artifact is exactly reproduced by the new +/-250 kb query
    old_in_r1_window = old[(old.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (old.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    q250_in_r1_window = q250[(q250.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (q250.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    same_ids = set(old.studyLocusId) == set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId)
    log(f"Round-1 303-row artifact == new +/-250 kb query restricted to 73.5-73.9 Mb: {same_ids} "
        f"(old={len(old)}, q250_restricted={len(q250_in_r1_window)})")
    if not same_ids:
        log(f"  IDs only in round-1 artifact: {len(set(old.studyLocusId) - set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId))}; "
            f"only in new query: {len(set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId) - set(old.studyLocusId))}")

    rel_old = os.path.relpath(old_path, BASE)
    rel_q250 = os.path.relpath(q250_path, BASE)
    rel_q500 = os.path.relpath(q500_path, BASE)

    # --- Reconciliation of the 303 / 123 / 116 / 67 counts
    recon = []
    recon.append(window_counts(
        old, "R1_QUERY_WINDOW: lead variant chr15:73,500,000-73,900,000 "
             "(window used by the round-1 region query; TSS -184,383 to +215,617)",
        R1_QUERY_LO, R1_QUERY_HI, rel_old))
    recon.append(window_counts(q250, "TSS +/-250 kb", WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI, rel_q250))
    recon.append(window_counts(q500, "TSS +/-500 kb", WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI, rel_q500))
    recon.append(window_counts(old, "CD276 gene body (lead variant inside gene span)",
                               GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_old))
    # Locus-interval sensitivity: two universes, labelled explicitly.
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        old, "CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; round-1 303-row universe, "
             "lead variant 73.5-73.9 Mb)",
        GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_old))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q500, "CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; full TSS +/-500 kb retrieval universe)",
        GENE_START, GENE_END, rel_q500))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q250, "TSS +/-250 kb (locus interval overlap)", WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI, rel_q250))
    recon.append(locus_overlap_counts(
        q500, "TSS +/-500 kb (locus interval overlap)", WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI, rel_q500))
    recon_df = pd.DataFrame(recon)
    recon_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables",
                              "cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv")
    recon_df.to_csv(recon_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {recon_path} ({len(recon_df)} rows)")
    for _, r in recon_df.iterrows():
        log(f"  {r.definition}: {r.n_credible_sets_all_types} sets / "
            f"{r.n_distinct_studies_all_types} studies (all types); "
            f"{r.n_credible_sets_gwas} GWAS sets / {r.n_distinct_gwas_studies} GWAS studies")

    # Pull the four gene-body definitions for the G7 note (all computed, none typed).
    def count_for(prefix, gwas):
        row = recon_df[recon_df.definition.str.startswith(prefix)]
        col = "n_credible_sets_gwas" if gwas else "n_credible_sets_all_types"
        return int(row[col].iloc[0])
    gb_lead_all = count_for("CD276 gene body (lead variant", False)

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Panel 4A stream 2: ENCODE-rE2G lung regulatory-element evidence at the CD276 locus.

Revision 2 (2026-10-22): BASE now resolves to THIS run's LIVE workspace, the
input md5 is recorded, and the delivered tables explicitly carry their filter so
that the 77-element within-window distribution is fully re-derivable.

Input (read-only shared staging area; path and md5 written to the summary):
  /mnt/beegfs/xqinag/projects/TheVirtualBiotech/runs/b7h3_round2_20261021/
      data/encode_e2g/ENCFF459TXD_lung_e2g_predictions.bed.gz
  Dataset ENCSR985HNP; DNase-only full predictions; biosample = lung.

Two orthogonal selections, kept distinct:
  (a) GENE-LINKED: TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855 (CD276), all distances
  (b) LOCUS-OVERLAPPING: element interval overlaps CD276 TSS +/- 500 kb
      (chr15:73,184,383-74,184,383, GRCh38)

The E2G Score is the ENCODE-rE2G/ABC-style predicted regulatory link score.
It is a regulatory-annotation score, NOT a genetic association statistic.

Outputs
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_regulatory_elements.csv                  (7,332 rows)
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_cd276_linked_all_839.csv                 (839 rows)
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_within_500kb_77_elements.csv             (77 rows)
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_within_window_score_distance_distribution.csv (77 rows)
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_within_window_score_distance_summary.csv
  results/tables/cd276_e2g_summary.csv
  data/processed/cd276_e2g_parse_log.txt
"""
import os
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Workspace root = .../work/genomics-analyst (script lives in code/scripts/)
BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
SRC = ("/mnt/beegfs/xqinag/projects/TheVirtualBiotech/runs/b7h3_round2_20261021/"
       "data/encode_e2g/ENCFF459TXD_lung_e2g_predictions.bed.gz")

CD276_ENSG = "ENSG00000103855"
GENE_START, GENE_END, TSS = 73_683_966, 73_714_514, 73_684_383
WIN_LO, WIN_HI = TSS - 500_000, TSS + 500_000
CHR = "chr15"

COLS = ["#chr", "start", "end", "name", "class", "TargetGene", "TargetGeneEnsemblID",
        "TargetGeneTSS", "isSelfPromoter", "CellType", "numTSSEnhGene.Feature",
        "distanceToTSS.Feature", "normalizedDNase_enh.Feature", "normalizedDNase_prom.Feature",
        "numNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "sumNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "ubiquitousExpressedGene.Feature",
        "numCandidateEnhGene.Feature", "3DContactAvgHicTrack2.Feature",
        "3DContactAvgHicTrack2_squared.Feature", "activityEnhDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2_squared.Feature",
        "activityPromDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "ABCScoreDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "Score"]

FILTER_LINKED = ("TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855 (CD276); all element-gene "
                 "link records, no distance restriction")
FILTER_WINDOW = (f"TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855 (CD276) AND element interval "
                 f"overlaps {CHR}:{WIN_LO}-{WIN_HI} (CD276 TSS +/-500 kb); "
                 f"one row per distinct element, 839-of-839 gene-linked records are unique elements")

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def md5_file(path, chunk=1 << 20):
    h = hashlib.md5()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for b in iter(lambda: fh.read(chunk), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables"), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed"), exist_ok=True)

    src_md5 = md5_file(SRC)
    src_size = os.path.getsize(SRC)
    log(f"Source: {SRC}")
    log(f"Source md5: {src_md5}; size_bytes: {src_size}")
    log(f"Selection A (gene-linked): TargetGeneEnsemblID == {CD276_ENSG}")
    log(f"Selection B (locus): #chr == {CHR} and element overlaps [{WIN_LO},{WIN_HI}] (TSS +/-500 kb)")

    kept = []
    n_rows = 0
    n_chunks = 0
    reader = pd.read_csv(
        SRC, sep="\t", header=0, names=COLS, comment=None,
        dtype={"#chr": str, "name": str, "class": str, "TargetGene": str,
               "TargetGeneEnsemblID": str, "isSelfPromoter": str, "CellType": str},
        chunksize=1_000_000, low_memory=False,
    )
    for chunk in reader:
        n_chunks += 1
        n_rows += len(chunk)
        gene_m = chunk["TargetGeneEnsemblID"] == CD276_ENSG
        s = pd.to_numeric(chunk["start"], errors="coerce")
        e = pd.to_numeric(chunk["end"], errors="coerce")
        locus_m = (chunk["#chr"] == CHR) & (s <= WIN_HI) & (e >= WIN_LO)
        m = gene_m | locus_m
        if m.any():
            sub = chunk.loc[m].copy()
            sub["selection_gene_linked"] = gene_m[m].values
            sub["selection_locus_overlap"] = locus_m[m].values
            kept.append(sub)
        if n_chunks % 2 == 0:
            log(f"  processed {n_rows:,} rows; retained so far {sum(len(x) for x in kept):,}")

    df = pd.concat(kept, ignore_index=True)
    log(f"Processed {n_rows:,} data rows in {n_chunks} chunks; retained {len(df):,} rows")

    # numeric coercion
    for c in ["start", "end", "TargetGeneTSS", "distanceToTSS.Feature", "normalizedDNase_enh.Feature",
              "normalizedDNase_prom.Feature", "numNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "sumNearbyEnhancers.Feature",
              "ABCScoreDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "Score"]:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")
    df["isSelfPromoter"] = df["isSelfPromoter"].astype(str).str.upper().eq("TRUE")

    # annotate relative to CD276
    df["element_length_bp"] = df["end"] - df["start"]
    df["element_midpoint"] = (df["start"] + df["end"]) / 2
    df["midpoint_distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp"] = df["element_midpoint"] - TSS
    df["overlaps_CD276_gene_body"] = (df["start"] <= GENE_END) & (df["end"] >= GENE_START)
    df["overlaps_TSS_250kb"] = (df["start"] <= TSS + 250_000) & (df["end"] >= TSS - 250_000)
    df["overlaps_TSS_500kb"] = (df["start"] <= TSS + 500_000) & (df["end"] >= TSS - 500_000)
    df["is_CD276_target_gene"] = df["TargetGeneEnsemblID"] == CD276_ENSG

    def scope(r):
        if r["is_CD276_target_gene"] and r["overlaps_TSS_500kb"]:
            return "gene_linked_and_locus_overlap"
        if r["is_CD276_target_gene"]:
            return "gene_linked_outside_locus_window"
        return "locus_overlap_not_linked_to_CD276"
    df["link_scope"] = df.apply(scope, axis=1)
    df["filter"] = np.where(
        df["is_CD276_target_gene"] & df["overlaps_TSS_500kb"], FILTER_WINDOW,
        np.where(df["is_CD276_target_gene"], FILTER_LINKED,
                 f"element interval overlaps {CHR}:{WIN_LO}-{WIN_HI}; target gene != CD276"))

    out_cols = ["#chr", "start", "end", "name", "class", "TargetGene", "TargetGeneEnsemblID",
                "TargetGeneTSS", "isSelfPromoter", "CellType", "normalizedDNase_enh.Feature",
                "normalizedDNase_prom.Feature", "numNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "ABCScoreDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature",
                "Score", "distanceToTSS.Feature", "element_length_bp", "element_midpoint",
                "midpoint_distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp", "overlaps_CD276_gene_body", "overlaps_TSS_250kb",
                "overlaps_TSS_500kb", "is_CD276_target_gene", "selection_gene_linked",
                "selection_locus_overlap", "link_scope", "filter"]
    out = df[out_cols].sort_values(["link_scope", "Score"], ascending=[True, False])
    out_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_e2g_regulatory_elements.csv")
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {out_path} ({len(out)} rows)")

    linked = df[df.is_CD276_target_gene].copy()
    locus = df[df.overlaps_TSS_500kb].copy()
    linked_locus = df[df.is_CD276_target_gene & df.overlaps_TSS_500kb].copy()

    # Dedicated, explicitly filtered deliverable tables.
    linked_out_cols = ["#chr", "start", "end", "name", "class", "Score",
                       "distanceToTSS.Feature", "isSelfPromoter", "overlaps_CD276_gene_body",
                       "overlaps_TSS_500kb", "filter"]
    linked_out = linked[linked_out_cols].sort_values("Score", ascending=False)
    linked_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_e2g_cd276_linked_all_839.csv")
    linked_out.to_csv(linked_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {linked_path} ({len(linked_out)} rows)")

    win_out = linked_locus[linked_out_cols].sort_values("Score", ascending=False)
    win_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_e2g_within_500kb_77_elements.csv")
    win_out.to_csv(win_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {win_path} ({len(win_out)} rows)")

    dist = linked_locus.sort_values("Score", ascending=False).copy()
    dist_out = pd.DataFrame({
        "element": dist["name"],
        "chr": dist["#chr"],
        "start_grch38": dist["start"].astype("int64"),
        "end_grch38": dist["end"].astype("int64"),
        "class": dist["class"],
        "isSelfPromoter": dist["isSelfPromoter"],
        "e2g_score": dist["Score"],
        "distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp": dist["distanceToTSS.Feature"],
        "filter": FILTER_WINDOW,
    })
    dist_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables",
                             "cd276_e2g_within_window_score_distance_distribution.csv")
    dist_out.to_csv(dist_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {dist_path} ({len(dist_out)} rows)")

    summ = pd.DataFrame([
        {"metric": "n_elements", "value": len(dist_out), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "e2g_score_median", "value": float(dist_out.e2g_score.median()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "e2g_score_min", "value": float(dist_out.e2g_score.min()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "e2g_score_max", "value": float(dist_out.e2g_score.max()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp_median", "value": float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp_min", "value": float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.min()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp_max", "value": float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.max()), "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "distance_to_CD276_TSS_kb_median", "value": float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median()) / 1000.0, "definition": FILTER_WINDOW},
        {"metric": "source_file", "value": SRC, "definition": "read-only shared staging input"},
        {"metric": "source_file_md5", "value": src_md5, "definition": "md5 of the gzipped BED input"},
        {"metric": "source_file_size_bytes", "value": src_size, "definition": "gzipped BED size"},
    ])
    summ_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables",
                             "cd276_e2g_within_window_score_distance_summary.csv")
    summ.to_csv(summ_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {summ_path} ({len(summ)} metrics)")

    log("")
    log(f"CD276-linked elements: {len(linked)} (unique element names: {linked['name'].nunique()})")
    log(f"Locus-overlapping elements (TSS +/-500 kb): {len(locus)} (unique names: {locus['name'].nunique()})")
    log(f"Both gene-linked and locus-overlapping: {len(linked_locus)} (unique names: {linked_locus['name'].nunique()})")
    log(f"Gene-linked but outside +/-500 kb: {int((df.is_CD276_target_gene & ~df.overlaps_TSS_500kb).sum())}")
    log(f"Locus-overlapping but target gene != CD276: {int((df.overlaps_TSS_500kb & ~df.is_CD276_target_gene).sum())}")
    log(f"Within-window score: median {dist_out.e2g_score.median():.6f} "
        f"(range {dist_out.e2g_score.min():.6f}-{dist_out.e2g_score.max():.6f}), n={len(dist_out)}")
    log(f"Within-window distance to TSS: median {dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median():.1f} bp "
        f"({dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median()/1000:.1f} kb; "
        f"range {dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.min():.1f}-{dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.max():.1f} bp)")

    summary = []
    def add(metric, value, notes=""):
        summary.append({"metric": metric, "value": value, "notes": notes})

    add("source_file", os.path.basename(SRC), "ENCODE-rE2G DNase-only lung predictions; dataset ENCSR985HNP")
    add("source_file_full_path", SRC, "read-only shared staging input")
    add("source_file_md5", src_md5, "md5 of the gzipped BED input")
    add("total_rows_in_file", n_rows, "number of element-gene link records scanned")
    add("locus_window", f"{CHR}:{WIN_LO}-{WIN_HI}", "CD276 TSS +/-500 kb, GRCh38")
    add("gene_body", f"{CHR}:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END}", "CD276 GRCh38 gene span")
    add("n_CD276_linked_elements", len(linked), "TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855")
    add("n_CD276_linked_unique_elements", linked["name"].nunique(), "distinct element intervals")
    add("n_locus_overlapping_elements", len(locus), "element interval overlaps TSS +/-500 kb")
    add("n_locus_overlapping_unique_elements", locus["name"].nunique(), "distinct element intervals")
    add("n_both_gene_linked_and_locus", len(linked_locus), "")
    add("n_within_window_unique_elements", linked_locus["name"].nunique(),
        "CD276-linked and within TSS +/-500 kb; the 77-element within-window set")
    add("within_window_score_median", float(dist_out.e2g_score.median()), FILTER_WINDOW)
    add("within_window_score_min", float(dist_out.e2g_score.min()), FILTER_WINDOW)
    add("within_window_score_max", float(dist_out.e2g_score.max()), FILTER_WINDOW)
    add("within_window_distance_to_TSS_bp_median", float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median()), FILTER_WINDOW)
    add("within_window_distance_to_TSS_kb_median", float(dist_out.distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp.median()) / 1000.0, FILTER_WINDOW)
    add("filter_link_table", FILTER_LINKED, "filter recorded in cd276_e2g_cd276_linked_all_839.csv")
    add("filter_window_table", FILTER_WINDOW, "filter recorded in cd276_e2g_within_500kb_77_elements.csv")

    add("class_taxonomy_note",
        "promoter/genic/intergenic",
        "This ENCODE-rE2G file has no 'enhancer' or 'intronic' class labels; distal candidate "
        "elements are labelled 'genic' or 'intergenic' and promoter elements 'promoter'.")
    add("primary_score_threshold", 0.02,
        "Pre-declared primary threshold: above the 95th percentile of CD276-linked scores (0.0148); "
        "isolates the upper tail; sensitivity at 0.05 and 0.1 also reported. Not calibrated to any paper count.")
    for group_name, g in [("CD276_linked", linked), ("locus_overlapping", locus)]:
        for cls, n in g["class"].value_counts(dropna=False).items():
            add(f"{group_name}__n_class_{cls}", int(n), "rows (element-gene links)")
            add(f"{group_name}__n_unique_class_{cls}", int(g.loc[g['class'] == cls, 'name'].nunique()),
                "distinct element intervals")
        add(f"{group_name}__n_isSelfPromoter_TRUE", int(g["isSelfPromoter"].sum()), "rows")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_min", float(g["Score"].min()), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_median", float(g["Score"].median()), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_mean", float(g["Score"].mean()), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_p90", float(g["Score"].quantile(0.90)), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_p95", float(g["Score"].quantile(0.95)), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__score_max", float(g["Score"].max()), "")
        for thr in [0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01, 0.005]:
            add(f"{group_name}__n_score_ge_{thr}", int((g["Score"] >= thr).sum()), "rows")
            add(f"{group_name}__n_unique_elements_score_ge_{thr}",
                int(g.loc[g["Score"] >= thr, "name"].nunique()), "distinct element intervals")
        add(f"{group_name}__distanceToTSS_min_bp", float(g["distanceToTSS.Feature"].min()), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__distanceToTSS_median_bp", float(g["distanceToTSS.Feature"].median()), "")
        add(f"{group_name}__distanceToTSS_max_bp", float(g["distanceToTSS.Feature"].max()), "")

    # class x score threshold cross-tab for linked set
    for thr in [0.1, 0.05, 0.02]:
        for cls in sorted(linked["class"].dropna().unique()):
            add(f"CD276_linked__class_{cls}__n_score_ge_{thr}",
                int(((linked["class"] == cls) & (linked["Score"] >= thr)).sum()), "")

    # top elements by score
    top = linked.sort_values("Score", ascending=False).head(20).reset_index(drop=True)
    for i in range(len(top)):
        r = top.loc[i]

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

       "data/encode_e2g/ENCFF459TXD_lung_e2g_predictions.bed.gz")

CD276_ENSG = "ENSG00000103855"
GENE_START, GENE_END, TSS = 73_683_966, 73_714_514, 73_684_383
WIN_LO, WIN_HI = TSS - 500_000, TSS + 500_000
CHR = "chr15"

COLS = ["#chr", "start", "end", "name", "class", "TargetGene", "TargetGeneEnsemblID",
        "TargetGeneTSS", "isSelfPromoter", "CellType", "numTSSEnhGene.Feature",
        "distanceToTSS.Feature", "normalizedDNase_enh.Feature", "normalizedDNase_prom.Feature",
        "numNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "sumNearbyEnhancers.Feature", "ubiquitousExpressedGene.Feature",
        "numCandidateEnhGene.Feature", "3DContactAvgHicTrack2.Feature",
        "3DContactAvgHicTrack2_squared.Feature", "activityEnhDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2_squared.Feature",
        "activityPromDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "ABCScoreDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "Score"]

FILTER_LINKED = ("TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855 (CD276); all element-gene "
                 "link records, no distance restriction")
FILTER_WINDOW = (f"TargetGeneEnsemblID == ENSG00000103855 (CD276) AND element interval "
                 f"overlaps {CHR}:{WIN_LO}-{WIN_HI} (CD276 TSS +/-500 kb); "
                 f"one row per distinct element, 839-of-839 gene-linked records are unique elements")

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def md5_file(path, chunk=1 << 20):
    h = hashlib.md5()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for b in iter(lambda: fh.read(chunk), b""):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables"), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed"), exist_ok=True)

    src_md5 = md5_file(SRC)
    src_size = os.path.getsize(SRC)
    log(f"Source: {SRC}")
    log(f"Source md5: {src_md5}; size_bytes: {src_size}")
    log(f"Selection A (gene-linked): TargetGeneEnsemblID == {CD276_ENSG}")
    log(f"Selection B (locus): #chr == {CHR} and element overlaps [{WIN_LO},{WIN_HI}] (TSS +/-500 kb)")

    kept = []
    n_rows = 0
    n_chunks = 0
    reader = pd.read_csv(

        dtype={"#chr": str, "name": str, "class": str, "TargetGene": str,
               "TargetGeneEnsemblID": str, "isSelfPromoter": str, "CellType": str},
        chunksize=1_000_000, low_memory=False,
    )
    for chunk in reader:
        n_chunks += 1
        n_rows += len(chunk)
        gene_m = chunk["TargetGeneEnsemblID"] == CD276_ENSG
        s = pd.to_numeric(chunk["start"], errors="coerce")
        e = pd.to_numeric(chunk["end"], errors="coerce")

        if m.any():

            sub["selection_gene_linked"] = gene_m[m].values
            sub["selection_locus_overlap"] = locus_m[m].values

              "ABCScoreDNaseOnlyAvgHicTrack2.Feature", "Score"]:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")
    df["isSelfPromoter"] = df["isSelfPromoter"].astype(str).str.upper().eq("TRUE")

    # annotate relative to CD276
    df["element_length_bp"] = df["end"] - df["start"]
    df["element_midpoint"] = (df["start"] + df["end"]) / 2
    df["midpoint_distance_to_CD276_TSS_bp"] = df["element_midpoint"] - TSS
    df["overlaps_CD276_gene_body"] = (df["start"] <= GENE_END) & (df["end"] >= GENE_START)
    df["overlaps_TSS_250kb"] = (df["start"] <= TSS + 250_000) & (df["end"] >= TSS - 250_000)

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Panel 4A revision 2: tabulate the GWAS trait-label counts used in the report.

Report claims audited here:
  - §1.3 "13/41" gene-body GWAS credible sets carry a trait label
  - G2 note "17/67" L2G loci carry a trait label

Trait labels are not present on the credible-set records themselves.  They are
taken from the round-1 L2G table (`trait_resolved`), keyed by studyId.  Every
studyId in the 41 gene-body GWAS credible sets is present in the L2G table, so
the map is complete; 13 of those 41 rows map to a non-null label.

Outputs
  results/tables/cd276_gwas_trait_label_audit.csv
  data/processed/cd276_trait_label_audit_log.txt
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
RAW = os.path.join(BASE, "data", "raw")

GENE_START, GENE_END = 73_683_966, 73_714_514

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def main():
    cs_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    l2g_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_l2g_predictions.csv")
    cs = pd.read_parquet(cs_path)
    l2g = pd.read_csv(l2g_path)

    # one trait label per studyId (first non-null); all labels for a study are identical
    trait_map = (l2g.dropna(subset=["trait_resolved"])
                 .groupby("studyId")["trait_resolved"].first())

    rows = []

    def emit(dataset, dataset_definition, denominator, series, source_file):
        """series = labelled trait values (NaNs included); counts include unlabelled."""
        vc = series.value_counts(dropna=False)
        for label, n in vc.items():
            rows.append({
                "dataset": dataset,
                "dataset_definition": dataset_definition,
                "trait_label": "UNLABELLED" if pd.isna(label) else str(label),
                "n_rows": int(n),
                "denominator": int(denominator),
                "numerator_definition": (
                    "count of rows in this dataset whose studyId maps to this non-null "
                    "trait_resolved value in data/raw/cd276_l2g_predictions.csv"
                    if not pd.isna(label) else
                    "count of rows in this dataset whose studyId has no non-null "
                    "trait_resolved value in data/raw/cd276_l2g_predictions.csv"),
                "source_file": source_file,
            })

    # (1) gene-body GWAS credible sets: 41
    gb = cs[(cs.position >= GENE_START) & (cs.position <= GENE_END)
            & (cs.studyType == "gwas")].copy()
    gb["studyId"] = gb["studyId"].astype(str)
    gb["trait_resolved"] = gb["studyId"].map(trait_map)
    emit("gene_body_gwas_credible_sets",
         f"GWAS credible sets with lead variant in CD276 gene body chr15:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END} "
         f"(data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet, studyType == 'gwas')",
         len(gb), gb["trait_resolved"], "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    log(f"gene-body GWAS credible sets: {len(gb)}; labelled {gb.trait_resolved.notna().sum()}; "
        f"unlabelled {gb.trait_resolved.isna().sum()}")

    # (2) gene-body credible sets, all study types: 65 (supporting, not a headline claim)
    gba = cs[(cs.position >= GENE_START) & (cs.position <= GENE_END)].copy()
    gba["studyId"] = gba["studyId"].astype(str)
    gba["trait_resolved"] = gba["studyId"].map(trait_map)
    emit("gene_body_all_credible_sets",
         f"all-study-type credible sets with lead variant in CD276 gene body "
         f"chr15:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END}",
         len(gba), gba["trait_resolved"], "data/raw/cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    log(f"gene-body all-type credible sets: {len(gba)}; labelled {gba.trait_resolved.notna().sum()}; "
        f"unlabelled {gba.trait_resolved.isna().sum()}")

    # (3) L2G loci: 67
    emit("l2g_loci",
         "all L2G rows returned for ENSG00000103855 (67 distinct studyLocusId)",
         len(l2g), l2g["trait_resolved"], "data/raw/cd276_l2g_predictions.csv")
    log(f"L2G loci: {len(l2g)}; labelled {l2g.trait_resolved.notna().sum()}; "
        f"unlabelled {l2g.trait_resolved.isna().sum()}")

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    out_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_gwas_trait_label_audit.csv")
    out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)
    log(f"Wrote {out_path} ({len(out)} rows)")

    # explicit reconciliation of the two prose claims
    n41 = int(gb.trait_resolved.notna().sum())
    n67 = int(l2g.trait_resolved.notna().sum())
    log("")
    log(f"Claim 13/41  -> recomputed {n41}/{len(gb)}  [{'MATCH' if n41 == 13 else 'MISMATCH'}]")
    log(f"Claim 17/67  -> recomputed {n67}/{len(l2g)}  [{'MATCH' if n67 == 17 else 'MISMATCH'}]")
    log(f"41 studyIds present in L2G table: {gb.studyId.isin(set(l2g.studyId)).sum()}/41")

    with open(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed", "cd276_trait_label_audit_log.txt"), "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(LOG) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Consistency checks for the panel 4A outputs. Fails loudly on any mismatch.

Revision 2 (2026-10-22): paths resolve against this LIVE workspace; checks added
for the two gene-body locus-overlap universes, the stored within-window score and
distance distributions, and the trait-label audit.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Workspace root = .../work/genomics-analyst (script lives in code/scripts/)
BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
T = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables")
F = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "figures")
R = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "reports")

errors = []


def check(name, got, want):
    ok = got == want
    print(f"[{'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {name}: got={got!r} want={want!r}")
    if not ok:
        errors.append(name)


ver = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv"))
check("verification rows", len(ver), 9)
check("verification check ids", list(ver.check_id), [f"G{i}" for i in range(1, 10)])

rec = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv"))
check("reconciliation rows", len(rec), 8)
r = rec.set_index("definition")
check("303 all types", int(r.loc[r.index.str.startswith("R1_QUERY"), "n_credible_sets_all_types"].iloc[0]), 303)
check("303 -> 123 gwas", int(r.loc[r.index.str.startswith("R1_QUERY"), "n_credible_sets_gwas"].iloc[0]), 123)
check("303 -> 116 gwas studies", int(r.loc[r.index.str.startswith("R1_QUERY"), "n_distinct_gwas_studies"].iloc[0]), 116)
check("250kb all", int(r.loc["TSS +/-250 kb", "n_credible_sets_all_types"]), 599)
check("250kb gwas", int(r.loc["TSS +/-250 kb", "n_credible_sets_gwas"]), 224)
check("500kb all", int(r.loc["TSS +/-500 kb", "n_credible_sets_all_types"]), 1252)
check("500kb gwas", int(r.loc["TSS +/-500 kb", "n_credible_sets_gwas"]), 545)
check("gene body all", int(r.loc["CD276 gene body (lead variant inside gene span)", "n_credible_sets_all_types"]), 65)
check("gene body gwas", int(r.loc["CD276 gene body (lead variant inside gene span)", "n_credible_sets_gwas"]), 41)
gb_r1 = r.loc[r.index.str.startswith("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; round-1")]
gb_full = r.loc[r.index.str.startswith("CD276 gene body (locus interval overlap; full")]
check("gene body locus overlap round-1 universe all", int(gb_r1["n_credible_sets_all_types"].iloc[0]), 69)
check("gene body locus overlap round-1 universe gwas", int(gb_r1["n_credible_sets_gwas"].iloc[0]), 65)
check("gene body locus overlap full universe all", int(gb_full["n_credible_sets_all_types"].iloc[0]), 201)
check("gene body locus overlap full universe gwas", int(gb_full["n_credible_sets_gwas"].iloc[0]), 195)
check("250kb locus overlap gwas", int(r.loc["TSS +/-250 kb (locus interval overlap)", "n_credible_sets_gwas"]), 134)
check("500kb locus overlap gwas", int(r.loc["TSS +/-500 kb (locus interval overlap)", "n_credible_sets_gwas"]), 286)
check("source files unambiguous", int(rec.source_file.str.contains(" or ").sum()), 0)
check("every reconciliation row has a definition", int(rec.definition.isna().sum()), 0)

# G7 note must contain both computed universes and must not be a bare literal
g7 = ver.set_index("check_id").loc["G7"]
check("G7 note states round-1 universe 69/65", "69 all types / 65 GWAS" in g7.note, True)
check("G7 note states full universe 201/195", "201 all types / 195 GWAS" in g7.note, True)
check("G7 note cites the reconciliation table", "cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv" in g7.note, True)

ps = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv"))
check("per-study rows", len(ps), 8)
check("per-study with 500kb hit", int((ps.lead_variant_within_500kb_of_TSS > 0).sum()), 0)
check("per-study with gene-body hit", int((ps.lead_variant_in_CD276_gene_body > 0).sum()), 0)
check("per-study with locus overlap 500kb", int((ps.credible_set_locus_overlaps_500kb > 0).sum()), 0)
check("min chr15 distance", int(ps.min_distance_chr15_lead_variant_to_CD276_TSS_bp.min()), 4881214)

e2g = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_e2g_regulatory_elements.csv"))
lin = e2g[e2g.is_CD276_target_gene]
win = lin[lin.overlaps_TSS_500kb].drop_duplicates("name")
check("E2G total retained rows", len(e2g), 7332)
check("CD276-linked rows", len(lin), 839)
check("window unique elements", len(win), 77)
check("window outside 500kb", int((~lin.overlaps_TSS_500kb).sum()), 762)
check("gene-body linked elements", int(lin.overlaps_CD276_gene_body.sum()), 6)
check("self-promoter linked", int(lin.isSelfPromoter.sum()), 1)
check("window class promoter", int((win["class"] == "promoter").sum()), 17)
check("window class genic", int((win["class"] == "genic").sum()), 31)
check("window class intergenic", int((win["class"] == "intergenic").sum()), 29)
for thr, want in [(0.1, 9), (0.05, 16), (0.02, 29), (0.01, 78), (0.005, 122)]:
    check(f"linked score >= {thr}", int((lin.Score >= thr).sum()), want)
check("all score>=0.02 within window", int((lin[lin.Score >= 0.02].overlaps_TSS_500kb).sum()), 29)
loc = e2g[e2g.overlaps_TSS_500kb]
for thr, want in [(0.1, 24), (0.05, 38), (0.02, 49)]:
    check(f"locus unique elements (any link) score >= {thr}",
          int(loc.loc[loc.Score >= thr, "name"].nunique()), want)
    check(f"locus unique CD276-linked elements score >= {thr}",
          int(loc.loc[(loc.Score >= thr) & loc.is_CD276_target_gene, "name"].nunique()),
          {0.1: 9, 0.05: 16, 0.02: 29}[thr])
check("every delivered row carries a filter", int(e2g.filter.isna().sum()), 0)

# Revision-2 deliverable tables
linked_tab = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_e2g_cd276_linked_all_839.csv"))
check("linked deliverable rows", len(linked_tab), 839)
check("linked deliverable has filter", int(linked_tab.filter.isna().sum()), 0)
win_tab = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(T, "cd276_e2g_within_500kb_77_elements.csv"))

## 0. The two evidence streams must not be conflated

| Stream | What it measures | Source | What a positive result would mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Genetic credible-set support** | Fine-mapped statistical association between a germline variant and a trait, and locus-to-gene assignment | Open Targets / genetics MCP credible sets and L2G | A heritable contribution of the CD276 locus to LUAD/SCLC risk |
| **Regulatory-element / E2G support** | Predicted enhancer–gene links from chromatin accessibility and sequence/activity models in a biosample | ENCODE-rE2G lung predictions (DNase-only) | CD276 is plausibly transcriptionally regulated from nearby elements in lung; **not** evidence of disease association |

The paper's Figure 4A caption mixes these. This report does not.

---

## 1. Germline stream — verify-and-reuse

### 1.1 Recomputed headline claims

| Check | Claim | Recomputed | Round-1 value | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | LUAD+SCLC GWAS studies with a CD276-locus credible set | **0/8** within ±500 kb; **0/8** in gene body; **0/8** even by credible-set locus-interval overlap | 0/8 | verified |
| G2 | L2G predictions derived from a LUAD or SCLC study | **0/67** (`is_luad_or_sclc` True in 0 rows; 0/67 study IDs match the 8 studies) | 0/67 | verified |
| G3 | Number of distinct L2G loci | **67** (65 distinct studies) | 67 | verified |
| G4 | Credible sets in the round-1 queried window | **303** | 303 | verified |
| G5 | GWAS-only credible sets in that window | **123** | 123 | verified |
| G6 | Distinct GWAS studies in that window | **116** | 116 | verified |
| G7 | Credible sets with a lead variant in the CD276 gene body | **65 all types / 41 GWAS** | 41 (GWAS) | verified, clarified |
| G8 | Any LUAD/SCLC study in the expanded ±500 kb window | **0/8** among 1,252 credible sets / 1,106 studies | not tested at this window | new |
| G9 | Round-1 303-row artifact reproducible | **yes** — identical `studyLocusId` set (303/303) | — | new |

Source: `results/tables/cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv`; per-study detail in `results/tables/cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv`.

The eight studies are the five LUAD studies (GCST90297563, GCST90455522, GCST90134662, GCST008836, GCST004744) and three SCLC studies (GCST004746, GCST90134664, FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC); 56 credible sets were retrieved across them. Their nearest chr15 credible set to the CD276 TSS is **4,881,214 bp** away (the 15q25 nicotinic-receptor region). The 0/8 result holds whether "at the locus" is defined by lead-variant position (±500 kb, gene body) or by credible-set locus-interval overlap.

### 1.2 Resolving the 303 / 123 / 116 / 67 ambiguity

The round-1 report mixed counts from **four different definitions**. Recomputation from the saved artifacts (and two independent fresh region queries at ±250 kb and ±500 kb) gives:

| Definition | Window (GRCh38) | Filter | Credible sets, all study types | Distinct studies, all types | GWAS sets | GWAS studies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Round-1 query window | chr15:73,500,000–73,900,000 (TSS −184,383 to +215,617) | lead variant in window | **303** | **286** | **123** | **116** |
| TSS ±250 kb | chr15:73,434,383–73,934,383 | lead variant in window | 599 | 551 | 224 | 203 |
| TSS ±500 kb | chr15:73,184,383–74,184,383 | lead variant in window | 1,252 | 1,106 | 545 | 445 |
| CD276 gene body | chr15:73,683,966–73,714,514 | lead variant in window | 65 | 63 | 41 | 41 |
| TSS ±250 kb (sensitivity) | ±250 kb | credible-set locus interval overlaps window | 138 | 114 | 134 | 113 |
| TSS ±500 kb (sensitivity) | ±500 kb | credible-set locus interval overlaps window | 298 | 203 | 286 | 199 |
| Gene body (sensitivity) | gene span | credible-set locus interval overlaps window | 201 | 132 | 195 | 130 |

Source: `results/tables/cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv`.

**What each round-1 number actually is:**

- **303** = every credible set of **any study type** whose lead variant lies in the round-1 retrieval window (73.5–73.9 Mb). Breakdown: 123 GWAS, 104 eQTL, 56 sQTL, 16 tuQTL, 4 pQTL. It is **not** a ±500 kb count.
- **123** = the **GWAS-only subset** of the same 303 rows.
- **116** = the number of **distinct GWAS studies** contributing those 123 rows (6 studies contribute more than one credible set; maximum 3).
- **67** = **distinct L2G loci** from the gene-based L2G query. These are a subset of the 123 GWAS credible sets (all 67 IDs are present in the 123; all 67 are GWAS). L2G assigned CD276 as the likely target gene at 67 of the 123 GWAS loci.
- The round-1 **41** is the GWAS-only count of lead variants inside the CD276 gene body. The all-study-type count is 65.

An independent re-query of TSS ±250 kb restricted to 73.5–73.9 Mb returned exactly the same 303 `studyLocusId`s as the round-1 artifact — no missing or extra loci. The expanded queries (599 rows at ±250 kb; 1,252 at ±500 kb) are consistent with the round-1 retrieval being complete for its stated window and simply narrower than ±250 kb.

**Why the ±250/±500 kb counts are larger than 303:** the analysis window, not the gene, determines the count. The 73.5–73.9 Mb round-1 window excludes dense eQTL/sQTL tracks that begin just outside it. The pre-declared primary definitions in this report are the **lead-variant position** definitions (a lead variant inside the gene body, or within ±500 kb); locus-interval overlap is reported only as a sensitivity because fine-mapped locus intervals here can span several megabases and overstate proximity to CD276.

**Trait composition caveat (two places where round 1 over-stated).**

- Of the 41 gene-body GWAS credible sets, only **13/41** carry a trait label in the saved artifacts (ALT, AST, AST/ALT ratio, GGT, SHBG); the other 28 are unlabelled. The defensible claim is narrower: **none of the 41 belongs to any of the 8 LUAD/SCLC studies**.
- Of the 67 L2G loci, only **17/67** carry a trait label (ALT, AST, GGT, AST/ALT ratio, SHBG, BMI); the remaining 50 study IDs are unlabelled. None of the 8 LUAD/SCLC study IDs appears. Round 1's statement that all 67 "come from biomarker/other-trait GWAS" is not fully verifiable from its saved table, although the annotated subset is consistent with it.

These are corrections to round-1 wording, not to its conclusion: the disease-matched negative result rests on study IDs, not on trait labels.

### 1.3 Interpretation and limits of the negative result

- The genetics database stores fine-mapped/curated credible sets, not genome-wide summary statistics. "0/8" means **no CD276-locus credible set in the queried data** for the largest available LUAD/SCLC GWAS; it does not exclude a sub-threshold or non-fine-mapped association. This limitation is unchanged from round 1.
- The 67 L2G loci are real but disease-mismatched: none is one of the eight LUAD/SCLC studies, and the 17 with trait labels are liver-enzyme/SHBG/BMI traits. Their high scores (56 ≥ 0.5; maximum 0.953, ALT levels) show CD276 is a strong effector gene at a pleiotropic biomarker/other-trait locus, **not** a LUAD/SCLC causal gene. Trait labels are unavailable for 50/67 loci in the saved table.
- There is no disease-QTL colocalization to report for LUAD/SCLC because neither disease has a GWAS locus at CD276 (round-1 QTL table: `cd276_qtl_colocalization_summary.csv`).
- **Conclusion of stream 1:** genetic credible-set support for CD276 as a LUAD or SCLC causal target is **ABSENT** in the queried genetics database.

**G7 note, revised.** The previous G7 note quoted "69 all types / 65 GWAS" for locus-interval overlap without saying which credible-set universe it came from; the reconciliation table simultaneously printed 201/195 for the same word. The eight studies are the five LUAD studies (GCST90297563, GCST90455522, GCST90134662, GCST008836, GCST004744) and three SCLC studies (GCST004746, GCST90134664, FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC); 56 credible sets were retrieved across them. # Evidence Citation

## Why this exists

Your findings become claims in the CSO's answer to the user. Each claim is
clickable: a reader opens it and sees the table, figure, code line or tool call
behind it. The CSO can only build that from what you hand it, and **it must not
invent citations** — the system rejects evidence pointers that do not resolve.

So a finding you report without evidence is one the CSO has to present as
unsupported. Everything below is about making sure that does not happen to work
you actually did.

## 1. Write it down before you assert it

A number that exists only in your prose cannot be cited.

Before stating a result, save the thing that shows it:

| You want to say | Save |
|---|---|
| "highest in mast cells" | the per-cell-type table |
| "L2G score 0.75" | the credible-set table you read it from |
| "expression is bimodal" | the plot |
| "no black-box warning" | the query result |

This is not bookkeeping. If the only record of a result is a sentence, nobody can
check it, and in six months neither can you.

## 2. Put it in the right place

You have your own directory. Use the layout:

```
work/<your-agent-name>/
├── code/scripts/         analysis scripts you write
├── data/raw/             data as pulled from a tool or database
├── data/processed/       data after your QC / transformation
└── results/
    ├── figures/          plots (.png, .pdf)
    ├── tables/           result tables (.csv, .tsv, .parquet)
    └── reports/          your written findings (.md)
```

Absolute paths, always. Do not write into another specialist's directory or into
the run root.

**Name for content, not sequence.** `il33_celltype_expression.csv`, not
`analysis2.csv`. `gwas_credible_sets_chr9.parquet`, not `cs_2fd0.parquet`. Every
file you leave behind is something a human has to interpret without you there.

## 3. Say what each output shows

The system records every file you write automatically — you do not need to do
anything for an artifact to exist. What it cannot infer is what the file
*demonstrates*. For each output that carries a finding:

```python
register_artifact(
  path="results/tables/il33_celltype_expression.csv",
  description="Mean IL1RL1 expression per lung cell type across 12 donors; "
              "mast cells highest at 2.4 CPM")
```

One line. What is in it, and what it shows.

## 4. Return findings with evidence attached

Structure your response to the CSO so each substantive finding carries its
evidence:

```
FINDING: IL1RL1 is most highly expressed in lung mast cells (mean 2.4 CPM,
         3.1x the next-highest cell type).
EVIDENCE: results/tables/il33_celltype_expression.csv (row: mast cell)
          results/figures/il33_celltype.png
CONFIDENCE: strong — direct measurement, n=12 donors, consistent across 3 datasets

FINDING: Expression in cardiac tissue is low but non-zero.
EVIDENCE: results/tables/il33_critical_organs.csv (rows: cardiac_*)
CONFIDENCE: moderate — only 2 donors with cardiac tissue; wide CI
```

Paths relative to your own directory are fine — the CSO resolves them.

If a specific tool call is the evidence (an MCP query whose result you are
reporting directly rather than a file you wrote), give its `tool_use_id`.

## 5. Report what you could not establish

If a query failed, returned nothing, or the evidence is too thin to support a
conclusion — that is your result. Say it:

```
NOT ESTABLISHED: Cardiac expression could not be assessed. The Census query for

An acknowledged gap is usable — the CSO can scope its answer around it, or send
someone back for it. A confident claim with nothing behind it is worse than
silence, because it looks the same as a supported one until someone checks.

## Checklist before you respond

- [ ] Every number I state exists in a file I wrote
- [ ] Files are under my own `work/<agent>/` tree, in the right subdirectory
- [ ] Filenames say what the files contain
- [ ] `register_artifact` called for each output carrying a finding
- [ ] Each finding in my response has an EVIDENCE line
- [ ] Confidence stated honestly, with the reason
- [ ] Anything I could not establish is stated, not omitted

## Anti-patterns

**Reporting a summary statistic without saving the underlying table.** The
summary is the claim; the table is the evidence. Both are needed.

**`results_final_v3.csv`.** If there are three versions, either two are dead —
delete them — or they differ in a way the filename should say.

**Burying the finding in a long narrative.** The CSO extracts claims from what
you return. A clearly delimited FINDING/EVIDENCE/CONFIDENCE block survives that
extraction; a paragraph where the result is in the fourth sentence may not.

**Overstating confidence to sound useful.** `moderate` with an honest reason is
more useful than `strong` that a reviewer later has to walk back.

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Panel 4A stream 1: verify-and-reuse the germline genetics result for CD276.

Revision 2 (2026-10-22): every input now resolves inside THIS run's LIVE
workspace (data/raw/).  The previous hardcoded BASE (20261021-080518) and the
hardcoded G7 locus-overlap literal have been removed.  Both gene-body
locus-interval counts are now recomputed and labelled with their source
universe, because they answer different questions:

  - 65 all types / 41 GWAS   lead variant inside the gene span (primary)
  - 201 all types / 195 GWAS locus interval overlaps the gene span, using the
                             full TSS +/-500 kb credible-set retrieval
  - 69 all types / 65 GWAS   locus interval overlaps the gene span, restricted
                             to the round-1 303-row artifact (lead variants in
                             chr15:73.5-73.9 Mb)

Inputs (all under <workspace>/data/raw/)
  cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet
  cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet
  round1_per_study/{luad,sclc}_*_credible_sets.parquet   (8 studies)
  cd276_l2g_predictions.csv

Outputs
  results/tables/cd276_round2_germline_verification.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv
  results/tables/cd276_round2_credible_set_window_reconciliation.csv
  data/processed/cd276_round2_germline_verification_log.txt
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Workspace root = .../work/genomics-analyst (script lives in code/scripts/)
BASE = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
RAW = os.path.join(BASE, "data", "raw")
PER_STUDY_DIR = os.path.join(RAW, "round1_per_study")

# CD276 GRCh38 coordinates (same coordinates round 1 resolved via Open Targets)
CHR = "15"
GENE_START = 73_683_966
GENE_END = 73_714_514
TSS = 73_684_383
WIN_250_LO, WIN_250_HI = TSS - 250_000, TSS + 250_000   # 73,434,383-73,934,383
WIN_500_LO, WIN_500_HI = TSS - 500_000, TSS + 500_000   # 73,184,383-74,184,383
R1_QUERY_LO, R1_QUERY_HI = 73_500_000, 73_900_000       # round-1 region query, lead-variant filter

STUDIES = {
    "GCST90297563": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Shi 2023)"),
    "GCST90455522": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Gorman 2024)"),
    "GCST90134662": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "GCST008836": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (Dai 2019)"),
    "GCST004744": ("LUAD", "Lung adenocarcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST004746": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (McKay 2017)"),
    "GCST90134664": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung carcinoma (Byun 2022)"),
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": ("SCLC", "Small cell lung cancer (FinnGen R12)"),
}
PER_STUDY_FILES = {
    "GCST90297563": "luad_GCST90297563_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90455522": "luad_GCST90455522_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134662": "luad_GCST90134662_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST008836": "luad_GCST008836_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004744": "luad_GCST004744_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST004746": "sclc_GCST004746_credible_sets.parquet",
    "GCST90134664": "sclc_GCST90134664_credible_sets.parquet",
    "FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC": "sclc_FINNGEN_R12_C3_SCLC_EXALLC_credible_sets.parquet",
}

LOG = []


def log(msg):
    print(msg)
    LOG.append(str(msg))


def read_region(path):
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    df["position"] = df["position"].astype("int64")
    return df


def window_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose lead variant lies in [lo, hi]."""
    m = (df.position >= lo) & (df.position <= hi)
    sub = df[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "lead variant position (studyLocusId.variantId) within window",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def locus_overlap_counts(df, label, lo, hi, source_file):
    """Count credible sets whose fine-mapped locus interval overlaps [lo, hi]."""
    d = df.dropna(subset=["locusStart", "locusEnd"]).copy()
    d["locusStart"] = d["locusStart"].astype("int64")
    d["locusEnd"] = d["locusEnd"].astype("int64")
    m = (d.locusStart <= hi) & (d.locusEnd >= lo)
    sub = d[m]
    g = sub[sub.studyType == "gwas"]
    return {
        "definition": label,
        "window_start_grch38": lo,
        "window_end_grch38": hi,
        "window_size_bp": hi - lo,
        "filter": "credible-set locus interval [locusStart,locusEnd] overlaps window "
                  "(rows with null locus bounds dropped)",
        "source_file": source_file,
        "n_credible_sets_all_types": len(sub),
        "n_distinct_studies_all_types": sub.studyId.nunique(),
        "n_credible_sets_gwas": len(g),
        "n_distinct_gwas_studies": g.studyId.nunique(),
    }


def main():
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables"), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(BASE, "data", "processed"), exist_ok=True)
    log(f"Workspace root resolved from script location: {BASE}")
    log(f"CD276 constants: chr{CHR}:{GENE_START}-{GENE_END}, TSS {TSS}")
    log(f"Windows: gene body [{GENE_START},{GENE_END}]; +/-250 kb [{WIN_250_LO},{WIN_250_HI}]; "
        f"+/-500 kb [{WIN_500_LO},{WIN_500_HI}]; round-1 query [{R1_QUERY_LO},{R1_QUERY_HI}]")

    old_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_locus_credible_sets_all_studies.parquet")
    q250_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss250kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    q500_path = os.path.join(RAW, "cd276_tss500kb_region_query_round2.parquet")
    old = read_region(old_path)
    q250 = read_region(q250_path)
    q500 = read_region(q500_path)
    log(f"Loaded round-1 all-studies parquet: {len(old)} rows ({old_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-250 kb round-2 query: {len(q250)} rows ({q250_path})")
    log(f"Loaded +/-500 kb round-2 query: {len(q500)} rows ({q500_path})")

    # --- Verify the round-1 303-row artifact is exactly reproduced by the new +/-250 kb query
    old_in_r1_window = old[(old.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (old.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    q250_in_r1_window = q250[(q250.position >= R1_QUERY_LO) & (q250.position <= R1_QUERY_HI)]
    same_ids = set(old.studyLocusId) == set(q250_in_r1_window.studyLocusId)
    log(f"Round-1 303-row artifact == new +/-250 kb query restricted to 73.5-73.9 Mb: {same_ids} "
        f"(old={len(old)}, q250_restricted={len(q250_in_r1_window)})")
    if not same_ids:

    for _, r in recon_df.iterrows():

    # --- Per-study LUAD/SCLC check, recomputed from full per-study credible-set pulls
    per_study = []
    for sid, fname in PER_STUDY_FILES.items():
        path = os.path.join(PER_STUDY_DIR, fname)

        else:

        hist, label = STUDIES[sid]
        per_study.append({
            "histology": hist, "study_id": sid, "study_label": label,

            "min_signed_distance_bp": min_signed,
            "lead_variant_in_CD276_gene_body": int(((df.position >= GENE_START) & (df.position <= GENE_END)).sum()),
            "lead_variant_within_250kb_of_TSS": int(((df.position - TSS).abs() <= 250_000).sum()),
            "lead_variant_within_500kb_of_TSS": int(((df.position - TSS).abs() <= 500_000).sum()),
            "credible_set_locus_overlaps_CD276_gene_body": int(
                ((df.locusStart <= GENE_END) & (df.locusEnd >= GENE_START)).sum()),
            "credible_set_locus_overlaps_500kb": int(
                ((df.locusStart <= WIN_500_HI) & (df.locusEnd >= WIN_500_LO)).sum()),
        })
    ps = pd.DataFrame(per_study)
    ps_path = os.path.join(BASE, "results", "tables", "cd276_round2_per_study_locus_check.csv")
